speaker: Bean
text: I can crawl up the ladder halfway if you'll get my upper; and I can crawl up the ladder and knock it off.

speaker: Conrad
text: There you go. That's a good idea; go ahead and do that.

speaker: Bean
text: See anything else above me?

speaker: Conrad
text: No. Just go ahead and start up the ladder.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay. Okay, babe. [Perhaps reading the plaque on the landing strut as he jumps up to the first rung] Apollo 12.

speaker: Conrad
text: There you go. You didn't quite make it [to the first rung]. There you go.

speaker: Bean
text: Oh, yes I did.

speaker: Conrad
text: Stay put.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay.

speaker: Gibson
text: Al, would you give us a mark when you're on the footpad?

speaker: Bean
text: Let me kick this.

speaker: Conrad
text: Wait a minute. Wait, wait.

speaker: Bean
text: [To Gibson] Roger. I'm off the footpad right now. I'm standing on the ladder. Pete's dusting the boots off, trying to keep some of this dust out of the LM.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger, Al. Thanks.

speaker: Conrad
text: Oh, man, is it dusty. Just hold still for a while.

speaker: Bean
text: Let me...

speaker: Conrad
text: Wait, wait, wait.

speaker: Bean
text: ...[garbled] a couple.

speaker: Conrad
text: Yeah, but let me brush... [Pause]

speaker: Bean
text: Well, you can get rid of a lot of it, kicking that way...

speaker: Conrad
text: Yeah.

speaker: Bean
text: ...Get it out of your soles of your boots.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay; go ahead on up.

speaker: Bean
text: Oh, okay. [Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: Ohh, I'm in this dingy television wire again. [Pause]

speaker: Bean
text: There we go.

speaker: Conrad
text: All right; I'll help you from back here as best I can.

speaker: Bean
text: That's a good idea. I'm going to raise my gold visor here so I won't scratch it; and just put my protective visor down. [Pause] There. [Pause] Now, see the hatch? When you come up, take a good look at the hatch [and look at the scratches it got when they got out at the start of the EVA]. [Pause] I'm really going to have to be tender about it. I'm not sure we're not going to want to put some tape over it or something. [Pause] Okay.

speaker: Conrad
text: All the way down. Raise your rear end. [Pause] That a boy. Got her. [Pause]

speaker: Bean
text: That's as far in as I can go. I'll just do a pushup.

speaker: Bean
text: Slide in some more. I'm in.

speaker: Conrad
text: Very good.

speaker: Bean
text: In the hatch, Houston.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger, Al. Copy. You're in.

speaker: Conrad
text: Maybe your old friendly Cerd [that is, CDR] will get the ETB.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay; just a second. Let me get my gear [the LEC]. [Pause] Okay. Just a second.

speaker: Conrad
text: An ETB and two cameras [inside the ETB] ready to come up. [Pause] Oh, there's my friend [the TV wire], again. Al Bean?

speaker: Bean
text: What?

speaker: Conrad
text: That thing's going to drive me buggy. Guess what.

speaker: Bean
text: Houston?

speaker: Gibson
text: [Making a mis-identification] Go ahead, Pete.

speaker: Bean
text: Do you want me to switch to lunar stay antenna right now while Pete's on the surface? Over.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger. That's affirmative. And Track Mode, Off.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay. I'm going to Lunar Stay right now; but we may lose comm for a second. If I don't hear from you, I'll come back up.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger.

speaker: Bean
text: Stay. [Long Pause] Houston, Apollo 12. How do you hear on Lunar Stay?

speaker: Gibson
text: Intrepid, you're loud and clear. Sounds like Pete did the job [of erecting the S-Band correctly].

speaker: Conrad
text: [Garbled] start this ETB and... [Stops to listen to Gibson] Sure did.

speaker: Bean
text: Got good signal strength, Houston?

speaker: Conrad
text: Go ahead and start the ETB up.

speaker: Bean
text: [To Gibson] I'm going Track Mode to Off.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger.

speaker: Bean
text: [To Conrad] Okay. Now... Just a second, Pete, I haven't got this ETB [means LEC] rigged. One second.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. [Pause]

speaker: Gibson
text: Intrepid, signal strength is good. [Pause]

speaker: Bean
text: Okay.

speaker: Conrad
text: Matter of fact, you sound stronger, Houston.

speaker: Gibson
text: I believe so, Pete.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay.

speaker: Bean
text: Need to mount it.

speaker: Conrad
text: Got it.

speaker: Bean
text: We've got it. Wait a second; let me clear a nice little room here for it. [Pause] Say, are we going to jettison this garbage bag at the end of this EVA, Pete?

speaker: Conrad
text: Yes, sir.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay, let me get it in good position.

speaker: Conrad
text: Why don't you throw it out right now?

speaker: Bean
text: That's a good idea.

speaker: Conrad
text: And I'll get rid of it [by tossing it under the descent stage].

speaker: Bean
text: That's a good idea; you can move it out of the way. That's a smart one. [Pause] Okay, here it comes. [Pause] Just a second.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay.

speaker: Bean
text: Just a second. [Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: Don't worry about it.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay. It won't bother us [during the LEC operations]. Get it when you come up.

speaker: Conrad
text: Haul her [the ETB] up.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay. Just a second. [Pause] Let me try something that might be just easier on all of us. I don't have to run one over a pulley; I can just pull it up, Pete.

speaker: Conrad
text: It doesn't weigh anything.

speaker: Bean
text: That's right! Who needs a pulley? It's easier this way.

speaker: Conrad
text: Wait a minute. Go ahead, pull. [Counting quickly] 1, 2, 3. That a boy.

speaker: Bean
text: Hey, I got an idea. Now, you pull. You pull.

speaker: Conrad
text: Wait a minute. Nah; it's making a mess [by throwing dirt everywhere]! Never mind. Just keep on pulling.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay. [Pause] Okay; just a second.

speaker: Conrad
text: All right. [Pause]

speaker: Bean
text: Equipment transfer bag, in. Secured. [Long Pause] Okay, bring her [the LEC hooks] on back, Pete.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. Wait, wait. Don't let it get hung up. Keep coming.

speaker: Bean
text: Let her go.

speaker: Conrad
text: No, wait a minute, now. Just keep it taut.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay.

speaker: Conrad
text: Ahhhh! See, you can't do it that way, Al. Take it easy. Just get it out slow. That a boy. That a boy. Now. Now, you can let go of it. [Long Pause] Here is that. [Pause] We got one rock box coming up. Okay, Al. Easy does it; easy does it. Wait a minute, now. Easy does it. Easy, easy! Easy! Easy! Easy! You're pulling when I don't want you to pull! Okay; now pull. [Pause] Okay. Now we've got to give it the heave-ho [to get it over the porch lip]. Ready? 1. 2. Pull.

speaker: Bean
text: Got it made. Okay, lift her up a little bit, Pete. Let it come forward.

speaker: Conrad
text: That baby is heavy.

speaker: Bean
text: That's right in the door, though! Let me slide that in here.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. Okay, Houston. One rock box inside.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger, Pete. Copy. One SRC in. [Long Pause]

speaker: Bean
text: Okay, bring her out.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. [Pause] Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait! This thing is like playing with a snake. [Al laughs] Okay. That a boy. Now; easy does it. Get all this good stuff [his end of the LEC] and put it over here in the gear pad. Okay; now. Hey, Al? Now, you're going to hang on to it [Al's end of the LEC] and hand it to me, right? So I can tie it on the porch? Al?

speaker: Bean
text: That's right!

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. [Pause] Am I dirty. [Long Pause] Okay, Houston. What do you want me to do? Get in?

speaker: Gibson
text: That's affirmative, Pete. If you've got the ETB and the rock box in, then climb in yourself. [Long Pause]

speaker: Gibson
text: Intrepid, Houston. [No answer; Long Pause] Intrepid, Houston. [No answer; Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: You all ready for me to come in, Al?

speaker: Bean
text: I'm ready. It's up to them.

speaker: Conrad
text: Wonder what happened to Houston.

speaker: Bean
text: I'm not sure that that Lunar Stay didn't do it. I'd rather go back on Track and get them back.

speaker: Gibson
text: Intrepid, Houston. Stand by.

speaker: Conrad
text: [Hearing Houston] Okay. What's your problem?

speaker: Gibson
text: Okay, we had a changeover from one site to another, down here. It was all on our end. No problem with your antenna. It's working well.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. You guys ought to call those things [the site handovers] out in advance. That's been happening all the way through this flight.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger, Pete. We concur.

speaker: Gibson
text: And go ahead and press on on the ingress.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. [Pause] All right, Houston. Mark. I'm on the footpad.

speaker: Gibson
text: Mark. [Long Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: [Jumping up to the first rung] That was easy.

speaker: Bean
text: I just closed my feedwater. You might want to do that, too.

speaker: Conrad
text: Probably a good idea. Let me see if I can find it back here. [Pause] Okay, I just closed mine. Coming up the ladder.

speaker: Bean
text: Gosh, you're shaking the whole LM.

speaker: Conrad
text: Sorry about that.

speaker: Bean
text: You'll get a warning, because you haven't got your feedwater, but that's okay. You've got cooling for quite a while.

speaker: Conrad
text: Yeah. Understand. Okay, one garbage bag [meaning the jettison bag ]. Anything else in there you want to get rid of?

speaker: Bean
text: Not a thing.

speaker: Conrad
text: All right, hand me the LEC.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay, the LEC's got kind of a little slip knot in it because the... Got it?

speaker: Conrad
text: Yeah.

speaker: Gibson
text: Pete, on your way through the hatch, will you give a check on the seal?

speaker: Conrad
text: Check on the seal.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay; I can see it probably better than he could from this side, Houston. Seal looks real good. I'll tell you what we did do; when we got out, we...

speaker: Conrad
text: I can't believe I did that.

speaker: Bean
text: Yeah, you did. Because I remember, you were hitting here and then when I backed up. I could... I'll tell you, we probably just ought to put a piece of tape over it.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. [Hearing a warning tone] That's my feedwater [garbled].

speaker: Bean
text: [Garbled] the skin on the hatch, and for about a 10-inch cut, there. And it didn't hurt the insulation; didn't hurt the hatch. And I don't know whether you want us to put a piece of tape on there or just forget it. It doesn't look like it's going to bother anything.

speaker: Conrad
text: I'd say just forget it.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay, Pete.

speaker: Conrad
text: Why don't you get over on your side?

speaker: Bean
text: Okay. Let me move over.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay.

speaker: Bean
text: I just checked your circuit breakers, and they're all good.

speaker: Conrad
text: All right. [Pause]

speaker: Bean
text: Just a second; I'm not out of the way, yet.

speaker: Conrad
text: All right; but I want you to hold the door for a minute while I...

speaker: Bean
text: Okay.

speaker: Conrad
text: ...close this front [ dump valve ]...

speaker: Bean
text: Well, I've got to get out of the way.

speaker: Conrad
text: ...front thing here.

speaker: Gibson
text: Pete, we concur. No tape.

speaker: Conrad
text: [To Al] All right.

speaker: Bean
text: [Responding to Gibson] Okay.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay.

speaker: Bean
text: Now, wait a second, Pete. Let me back up a little better.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. Tell me which way to go.

speaker: Bean
text: Just a second. Okay, you're just perfect. Shoot right on in. Put your chest down and your rear end up [probably to get the OPS and the top of the PLSS in]... There you go; got it. Go a little bit to the left. Get a little further [into the cabin] until your head bumps [against the midstep ]. Do a pushup and you're fat. Little bit to the left, little bit further to the left. That's it. Up.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay.

speaker: Bean
text: You're in the best possible position. Scoot in a little more. There; you got it.

speaker: Conrad
text: I'm in; no sweat.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay. Now careful when you turn around. You've got... [Garbled].

speaker: Conrad
text: Yeah.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay. Boy, you look dirty.

speaker: Conrad
text: Oh, you do, too.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay; once you turn around, I'll get this hatch. Okay, it says PLSS feedwater, close. We did that.  Forward hatch close and lock. When you're out of the way, I'll slide over and lock it.

speaker: Conrad
text: Am I out of the way?

speaker: Bean
text: Not yet.

speaker: Conrad
text: Wait until I turn around. Just a minute.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay?

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay.

speaker: Bean
text: Get down on my hands and knees and lock this thing.

speaker: Conrad
text: Yeah.

speaker: Bean
text: Need a push down.

speaker: Conrad
text: Wait just a second. Let me raise my visor so I can see what's going on in here. Okay?

speaker: Bean
text: Can you give me a push-me-down?

speaker: Conrad
text: I am pushing you down. [Pause] Need further [push down]?

speaker: Bean
text: Just back up and let me tilt further forward, which is just as good.

speaker: Conrad
text: I can't go back any further. [Pause] Why don't you let me close it?

speaker: Bean
text: Okay, see if you can reach it. It's just a little bit out of my reach; you might be able to get it. Okay, easy.

speaker: Conrad
text: I'm ready.

speaker: Bean
text: Let me get back here in the corner. Watch your PLSS. [Pause] There you go. [Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: Hatch closed.

speaker: Bean
text: Did you get it?

speaker: Conrad
text: Yep.

speaker: Bean
text: Good show.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay, next one. Dump valve, both Auto. I've verified this one; [and] verified that one.

speaker: Conrad
text: That one's Auto.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay. Let me look at something [in the checklist?] first. [Pause] Okay. [Reading] PLSS O2 and Press flags may come on during Repress. If PLSS O2 less than 10 percent, manually control cabin Repress to maintain positive PGA pressure. Forget it.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay; Lighting Annunciator and Numerics, [change from Dim to] Bright.

speaker: Conrad
text: Wait a minute, easy. [Pause] There you go.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay. Now I'm going to go over here, [please move] over just a little so I can turn around. Oh, you did your circuit breakers.

speaker: Conrad
text: [I've gotten out of the way] the best I can; easy does it. What are you trying to do?

speaker: Bean
text: Lookit, that stop button's depressed.

speaker: Conrad
text: Yeah.

speaker: Bean
text: I've got to turn around. Repress valve. Okay?

speaker: Conrad
text: Well, I can reach the Repress valve, if you want.

speaker: Bean
text: No, I've got it here. [Garbled] it. [Pause] Why don't you reach it? It may be better if you could. Can you reach...

speaker: Conrad
text: Cabin Repress to what? Auto?

speaker: Bean
text: Cabin Repress to Auto. Press Regs A and B to Cabin.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay.

speaker: Bean
text: Master Alarm and Cabin Repress [warning light comes on]. Let's watch the pressure. [Pause]

speaker: Bean
text: Cabin pressure is starting up. [Pause; re-pressurization is audible]

speaker: Conrad
text: One psi. [Pause]

speaker: Bean
text: Coming in.

speaker: Conrad
text: Huh?

speaker: Bean
text: It's coming in good. [Pause] [Garbled]

speaker: Conrad
text: Repress is looking good. [Pause]

speaker: Bean
text: Going ahead, PLSS O2, Off. [Garbled] That's it; a little bit more. [Long Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. PLSS O2, Off.

speaker: Bean
text: Can you verify that I've got mine off?

speaker: Conrad
text: What?

speaker: Bean
text: Will you verify that I got mine off? I'll pull your diverter valve up, and check the water, and you do have it up.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay, Houston. There's the cabin at 4.6.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay. Master Alarm. Let me turn it off.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger, Pete; we copy. We show that [4.6 psi] down here.

speaker: Bean
text: [reading from the last paragraph on the righthand side of Sur-60 ] Operate OPS Purge Valve to Depress suit as required. [Pause] Let me operate yours.

speaker: Conrad
text: Yeah, here.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay.

speaker: Bean
text: Here it comes.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. [Pause] Okay.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay. [Pause]  Cabin Repress valve closes at 4[.4 psi]. Verify Cabin Press stable. It is. [Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: Cabin Gas Return [Valve] to Auto.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay, Cabin Gas Return [valve], Auto.

speaker: Conrad
text: Wait a minute. Get over here.

speaker: Bean
text: Okay. [Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: Auto.

speaker: Bean
text: Suit Circuit Relief [valve], Auto.

speaker: Conrad
text: That's already Auto.

speaker: Bean
text: That's right, [because the checklist indicates verify]  Suit Gas Diverter [Valve] , Push/Cabin.

speaker: Conrad
text: Push/Cabin.

speaker: Bean
text: Verify EVA circuit breaker configuration. On your side [that is, CB panel 11]: Suit Fan number 1, Close.

speaker: Conrad
text: Wait just a second. [Pause] Suit Fan 1, Closed.

speaker: Bean
text: And I'll close the Suit Fan Delta-P [on CB panel 16].

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay.

speaker: Bean
text: And I'll also... Notice  ECS caution [and] H2O SEP [lights out] . And I've got them [that is, the two lights are out]. And Comm [section of CB panel 16], TV [circuit breaker], Open. Houston, do you want me to turn off the TV or leave it on?

speaker: Gibson
text: That's affirmative, Al. Turn it off [by opening the circuit breaker]. [Pause]

speaker: Bean
text: Okay, and it says Doff gloves, helmets, visors, and all that; and let's go off relay. We're going off relay right now, Houston.

speaker: Conrad
text: How do you want me to go, Al?

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger. Copy, you're going off relay.

speaker: Gibson
text: Intrepid, Houston. [Calls at increasing intervals, with no response]

speaker: Bean
text: Audio, Commander, and VHF A. Off; B. Receive.

speaker: Conrad
text: VHF A, Off; B, Receive.

speaker: Bean
text: Mode, ICS/Push-To-Talk. [Pause]

speaker: Gibson
text: Intrepid, Houston.

speaker: Conrad
text: Houston, Intrepid. Loud and clear; how us?

speaker: Gibson
text: We read you loud and clear. Say, are you folks still concerned about the water in the suit loop?

speaker: Conrad
text: I'd like to hear about it.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger. If you would like to try to get it out, you can blow it out and use the wipe rag that you have over in the aft part of the right-hand equipment stowage bag as a cleanup device. Or you could probably best put it right over the exit and catch it before you get it into the dust in the cabin.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. We're not going to worry about it right now. We want to get out of all this gear, and we will talk to you later.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger.

speaker: Conrad
text: PLSS Mode [both] zero, connect to LM Comm, [which is a step they did prior to 119:20:50] Okay. Audio Commander [and LMP] to VHF A. Off; B. Receive. A is Off; B is Receive. Mode. ICS/PTT; Relay. Off. Okay. Comm VHF, Off, Off, Off, On, Left, High; [Tape] recorder, Off; and Uplink Squelch, Off. All done. Okay. Verify descent O2 [greater than 35 percent]. Yeah, okay. Connect [LM] O2 supply to [PLSS], LMP first. Just a minute. Let me ease over here. [Pause] How did that get undone? Did you undo it?

speaker: Conrad
text: O2. [Pause] O2. What are you going to do? Oh, you don't want a connect yet. You're going to have to turn around [and] get this side to me. Right? Right? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, you've got to turn all the way around that way. That a boy. [Pause] [Garbled] [Long Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. Turn on... Wait a minute [while he finds his place in the checklist]. PLSS fill [valve] Open and then close after 2 minutes. I'll do it on my mark. [Pause] 3, Mark. [Long Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: [Not realizing he is broadcasting] Hey, Al Bean. That was a hell of a show. Too bad the TV didn't work. Would you recycle that stop button? I'd feel a lot better. [Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: I can't see it from here, Al. I'll have to wait. [Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: May be it. Although I think you tend to underestimate distances. [Long Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: You've got to go 2 minutes and you haven't... [Long Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: Hey, I... You got a false joint in it or something. It's a good thing the TV wasn't working. [Pause]

speaker: Conrad
text: Yeah. I got a lot of pictures of you around the ALSEP. I've got good pictures of you.

speaker: Gibson
text: Pete, we're reading you on VOX.

speaker: Conrad
text: You've got 2 minutes. Turn her off. [To Gibson] Okay. [Pause] Is it off? I don't know. Just a minute.

speaker: Public Affairs Officer
text: We've 5 minutes away from acquisition of the Command Module, Yankee Clipper. This is Apollo Control at 119 hours, 30 minutes. We will take the line down now for the news conference.

speaker: Gibson
text: Yankee Clipper, Houston.

speaker: Gordon
text: Hello, Houston; Clipper here.

speaker: Gibson
text: Clipper, you were sort of a forgotten man for a little while. We're all - all eyes are on you now. We're with you.

speaker: Gibson
text: And, Clipper, the EVA was completed.

speaker: Gordon
text: Okay, Ed. I've got a little - will you clean up that [garble] channel? I've got an echo in here.[Long pause.]

speaker: Gibson
text: Yankee Clipper, how do you read?

speaker: Gordon
text: There you go. Now, you're nice and clear.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger. They completed the EVA with a 4-hour, 1-minute EVA, and they got all of the objectives accomplished. They did a real swell job, and we're watching you, Dick.

speaker: Gordon
text: Well, I guess I'll go Vox, so it'll be easier for you people to follow on these onboard checklists as I go down here.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger, Dick.

speaker: Gordon
text: Nobody is checking on me today.

speaker: Gibson
text: We're watching you now, Babe.

speaker: Gordon
text: Okay, I have everything down to 6 minutes - it's all done.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger. [Long pause.]

speaker: Gordon
text: Okay, I'm going to slide across the ballroom and get the Bus Ties.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger.

speaker: Gordon
text: Okay, the Bus Ties are On MTVC Servo Power 1, AC 1/Main A; 2, AC 2/Main B; Rotational Hand Controller Power, Normal, two, AC; Direct, two are Off; BMAG, three, ATT 1/RATE 2; Spacecraft Control's to SCS; Rotational Hand Controller number 2 is Armed. And we'll go into Primary TVC check. Gimbal motors: Motor l, Pitch 1; I've got it - one, Yaw - mark, I've got it. That's it. Pitch. Now, I've got Trim and Yaw. Trim is set - minus 73, plus 51. I have MTVC. Spacecraft Control to CMC. Trim is zero. Translational Hand Controller, clockwise; no MTVC [garble] number 2, Pitch - mark. I've got it. Yaw 2 - mark. I've got it. Trim is satisfactory. MTVC is satisfactory...

speaker: Conrad
text: Houston, Intrepid.

speaker: Gibson
text: Intrepid, Houston. Go ahead.

speaker: Conrad
text: Roger. How far behind time are we?

speaker: Gibson
text: Stand by...

speaker: Conrad
text: I'll put it this way. Aren't we supposed to be doing a '119:45'?

speaker: Gibson
text: Intrepid. We're coming up on a burn with Dick right now, about 4 minutes and 30 seconds away.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. We'll go - we'll be off the air.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger.

speaker: Gordon
text: ...Neutral and no MTVC. Rotational Hand Controller, two, AC/DC, Direct, two, Main A, Main B; BMAG's, Rate 2. Trim; okay, it's trimmed. Att1/Rate 2, Entered. Gimbal drive test: plus 2, minus 2, zero; plus 2, minus 2, zero. In 4 seconds, I'll have Trim, I hope. Okay, that's Trim; 03:47 time; FDAI scale 5/5; Limit Cycle is Off; Rate is High; DET is 1 second fast.

speaker: Gibson
text: Clipper, Houston. I remind you, we'd like to have all Thrusters Armed.

speaker: Gordon
text: Delta-V Thrust A is Normal; Translational Hand Controller is Armed; Rotational Hand Controller is Armed; Helium Valves are Auto; stand by for average g.

speaker: Gibson
text: You're looking good here, Dick.

speaker: Gordon
text: Thank you.

speaker: Gordon
text: DSKY Blanks. DSKY is hot and EMS is Normal. Ullage: I have Ullage. Proceed. Thrust, On [garble] 5 seconds. Looking good.

speaker: Gordon
text: Shutdown.

speaker: Gordon
text: A and B are Off; Pitch 2 is Off; Yaw 1 is Off; Pitch 1 is Off.

speaker: Gibson

text: Okay.

speaker: Gordon
text: Okay. I copied that.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger. We copy. [Long Pause] Pete, our intent on that comment about the PLSS [means 'ECS'] O2 hoses is to be assured that those hoses are straight and that you do get all the water running out of them, that there's no low places in the hoses in which the water can lie.

speaker: Conrad
text: Okay. Drain the hoses. That's the idea. Okay.

speaker: Gibson
text: That's affirm.

speaker: Gordon
text: Hello, Houston. How do you hear me now in High Gain.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger. And in the Reacq Mode, you went off.

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger, Dick [Long pause.]

speaker: Gibson
text: Say, Dick. That was a fantastic job you did on picking up the Surveyor and the LM. That was well done. Plus the burn change - the plane change on the burn. You have been doing a good job.

speaker: Gordon
text: Thank you, sir.

speaker: Gibson
text: Clipper. Omni Bravo. Clipper, Omni Bravo.

speaker: Conrad
text: Houston, we're going to modulate PM. [Long Pause]

speaker: Gibson
text: Intrepid, ready to copy.

speaker: Conrad

speaker: Gibson
text: Roger, Pete.

speaker: Gordon
text: No negative. I'm on High Gain right now. Would you like me to go to Omni Bravo?

speaker: Gibson
text: That's affirmative, Dick. Go Omni Bravo, present time.

speaker: Gordon
text: Houston, Yankee Clipper. I just got a Master Alarm on the caution and warning display.

speaker: Gibson
text: Okay, Yankee Clipper. Roger. Copy Master Alarm.

speaker: Gibson
